I'm really sorry to hear that you're feeling this way. It sounds like you're going through a difficult time, and it's important to take your feelings seriously. If you're feeling overwhelmed, isolated, or like you're stuck in an unhealthy situation, reaching out to someone you trust—like a close friend, family member, or counselor—can be a great first step.

If you're in immediate danger or feeling like you're in a situation where you're not safe, please reach out to a local emergency service or mental health hotline. Your safety and well-being are the most important things.

If you’re open to it, I’d be happy to listen and support you in any way I can. You don’t have to go through this alone. 💛
